title: better-tp
description: The player uses a simple command to teleport to a designated location at the cost of some health。玩家使用简单的指令，消耗一部分健康为代价传送至指定地点
body:
English from "fanyi.Baidu.com" and me：
Allow players to create and teleport to teleportation points using simple commands
Command: /tpp
Create teleportation point: Hold the Star of the Nether/tpp set <sitename>
Teleport to teleportation point: /tpp <sitename>
View location list: /tpp list
Input /tpp help to view the help page

Visit sites.yaml to view and modify delivery point information in the following format:
Birthpoint: {User: System, SiteName: Birthpoint, World_Name: world, X: 123, Y: 67.0, Z: 456.0}

Currently, only basic functions are available. Features such as deleting and modifying locations through commands, configuring files, prohibiting players from creating teleportation points, and supporting multiple languages are not supported at this time. However, if anyone uses this plugin in the future, updates and open-sourcing will continue.

中文：
允许玩家使用简单指令创建和传送至传送点
指令：/tpp 
创建传送点：手持下界之星/tpp set <地名>
传送到传送点：/tpp <地名>
查看地点清单：/tpp list
输入/tpp help查看帮助页

访问sites.yaml可查看并修改传送点信息，格式如下：
出生点: {User: System, SiteName: 出生点, World_Name: world, X: 123, Y: 67.0, Z: 456.0}

此插件为我的服务器制作，目前只有基础功能，暂不支持通过指令删除和修改地点,配置文件等功能，暂不支持禁止玩家创建传送点，暂不支持多语言，后续有人使用这个插件的话，会继续更新并且开源。问题反馈，建议，催更欢迎加入MC群：662655808![插件截图1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b763409be3a81b0ebfbdb0579244c084998fbc14.png)
